description: Frozen declaration-calibration-and-drift experiment configuration for the original-question closure (v1). Applied to whichever mechanism the architecture experiment selects under the frozen adaptive carrier rule (select_drift_carrier.py); the carrier name is read from DRIFT_CARRIER_DECISION.json and is not chosen here. The design, delta grid, declaration sources, arms as a function of the carrier, co-primary cells, pass rule, capacity/floor/bound construction, common-random-number discipline, seed namespace, and bootstrap are all frozen before any confirmatory seed or outcome is generated and must not be edited afterward. Declarations are constructed by a developer or platform integrator from finite calibration histories; strategic reporting is not modeled.
five_condition_rule: For the primary comparison (carrier_stale_calibration minus drf_stale_calibration) in each co-primary cell, using queue-order completion: (1) carrier mean completion higher than DRF; (2) paired 95% percentile bootstrap interval strictly above zero; (3) point estimate at least +1.000 completed task per 48-task run; (4) carrier does not increase the observed zero-completion fraction relative to DRF; (5) both arms have zero infeasibility, fallback, capacity, and bound violations. Both co-primary cells must pass for ROBUST_AT_MODEST_DRIFT.
common_random_numbers: The per-draw source uniform and the per-draw baseline-source and drift-target archetypes are fixed across delta levels within a scenario seed, so raising delta only switches draws whose uniform falls below delta. Drift-source draw count is recorded separately from the number of changed task identities.
monotonicity: Strict monotonicity over delta is neither required nor claimed.
